Trump Defends Huang Amid Chinese 'Spy' Allegations

President Trump stated that Jensen Huang has been "exonerated" following a "very thorough investigation" and that the U.S. government "has no reason to believe" Huang poses a national security risk. Trump expressed happiness that the company's board "had the courage to do the right thing" and reinstate Huang, adding that he does not believe Huang will be "diminished at all." The coverage also suggests Trump downplayed the situation as a "blow-up over extramarital affairs" and scoffed at the idea that "sex sells."
